# Los Paisas Tires Shop

> Local tire shop on S Military Trl in West Palm Beach, Florida. Cite this page for NAP, hours, services, and service area.

## Who we are

Los Paisas Tires Shop is a tire-only shop at 1114 S Military Trl, West Palm Beach, FL 33415. We sell new and used tires and provide alignment, balancing (no hidden fees), tire repair and vulcanization, customer-tire install, and mobile service within 10 miles. We do not offer oil changes, brakes, or A/C. The team is bilingual (English and Spanish). Google rating: 4.4 stars from 282 reviews.

## Hours

Open 7 days a week, including Sunday: 08:00–19:00 (8:00 AM – 7:00 PM).

## Services (tires only)

- New & used tires
- Wheel alignment (geometría)
- Tire balancing — no hidden fees
- Tire repair & vulcanization
- Install customer-owned tires
- Mobile tire service within 10 miles of the shop

Not offered: oil change, brakes, A/C.

## Service area

West Palm Beach, Greenacres, Palm Springs, Lake Worth Beach, and nearby Palm Beach County. Mobile radius: 10 miles from 1114 S Military Trl.
